title: A change with its intent, a test, and a document update passes the traceability rules
text:
diff --git a/src/a.py b/src/a.py
--- a/src/a.py
+++ b/src/a.py
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
-x = 1
+x = 2
+y = 3
diff --git a/tests/test_a.py b/tests/test_a.py
--- a/tests/test_a.py
+++ b/tests/test_a.py
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
+def test_y():
+    assert y == 3
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
+設定の既定値を x=2 に変更した。
intent: 設定の既定値を変更し README の説明も揃える
rationale: A change that states its intent, adds a test, and updates the document it promised must not be flagged for traceability or documentation.
